before_conditions: The vault has no funds deposited or managed yet, so totalAssets is initially 1.
The attacker can frontrun the first fulfillDeposits call.
The attacker has underlying tokens to donate to the vault.
The vault's share accounting uses the underlying token balance in computeNAV.
required_property: The share accounting should maintain the intended scaling so that deposits mint shares proportionally to the assets deposited, protecting depositors from loss of funds.
bad_outcome: The attacker's donation inflates totalAssets, breaking the share scaling and causing subsequent deposits to receive zero or disproportionately few shares, leading to uncapped loss of funds over several epochs.
